decisions.reason: The candidate already requires the token serial referral code in NFT metadata. Adding the distinct display location 'NFT itself' does not alter the metadata attributes.
Changing where the referral code is displayed does not change which referral identity or NFT properties follow the asset upon transfer.
Referral-code display locations do not change the commission allocation used when a mint has no referral code.
The display-location change does not alter the coded-referral commission trigger, recipient, amount, timing, or destination.
The referral code remains the same token serial, so displaying it on an additional surface does not alter ticket issuance.
Referral-code display locations do not change badge thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
The display-location change does not alter ticket allocation for mints that omit a referral code.
Referral-code display locations are independent of the randomness provider and winner-selection process.
The same-message FAQ replacement Event already captures the complete revised FAQ copy, including the revised referral-code display locations.
The referral-code display change does not alter the selected blockchain network or deployment scope.
Referral-code display locations have no effect on the deferred Discord launch condition.
The referral-code display change does not alter mint price, commission amount, founder share, or prize-pool destinations.
